note: Former Miller Lake Campground in the Medicine Bow NF, now a dispersed camping area with no designated sites or amenities, beside small Miller Lake about 35 miles west of Laramie (WY-230, then Forest Road 512 north toward Fox Park about 1 mile). Trout fishing in the lake. --Claude
summary: FS page read: no designated sites, dispersed area, no restrooms (vault_toilets true -> false), no water, 16-day limit, no rec.gov listing (FCFS). Lakeview holds on imagery (road along the lake end between). Pin fine. Criteria: no designated sites - reviewer's call.
flags: CRITERIA (report): the FS says 'This small campground no longer provides designated camp sites. It has become a dispersed camping area, meaning amenities are no longer offered' - the old loop road and pull-offs are still visible on imagery in an open clearing, reachable 1 mile up FR 512 from WY-230 (no 4WD or rig wording on the page). The FS page also lists 'OHV Camping' as an activity; it is not a staging camp. Kept as a dispersed drive-in area unless AWH rules otherwise. A camper report (The Dyrt via search, undated in the snippet) said facilities 'appeared to be locked'.
